items.headline: Wall Street shakes again as Nvidia and other jittery AI stocks swing lower
items.summary: Associated Press reported that Nvidia and other AI-related stocks led widespread U.S. market losses amid renewed concern about AI valuations and the sustainability of the sector’s investment boom.

items.headline: Ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang signals interest in returning to the company following scandal
items.summary: Associated Press reported that Jensen Huang indicated interest in returning to Nvidia after his resignation, while scrutiny continued over alleged export-control concerns involving a company executive linked to Nvidia’s chip supply chain.

items.headline: Stock Market Today: Major Index Futures Are Mixed After Monday’s AI Sell-Off as Investors Brace for Nvidia Earnings
items.summary: Yahoo Finance reported mixed index futures ahead of Nvidia earnings and noted rebounds in Nvidia-backed Nebius and Lumentum, alongside gains in memory and storage companies including SanDisk, Seagate, and Western Digital.

items.headline: Wall Street indexes retreat as Nvidia and AI stocks weigh on markets
items.summary: Associated Press reported that Nvidia and other volatile AI stocks pressured major U.S. indexes during Tuesday’s session.

items.headline: Vista Equity CEO on adapting to AI
items.summary: Axios reported on Vista Equity Partners CEO Robert F. Smith’s views on adapting software investment and enterprise strategy to frontier AI developments.
